# Draft:Golden Scythe Horror Awards

The Golden Scythe Horror Awards (GSHA) is an award ceremony focused on artistic and technical merit for film in the horror genre. They are presented annually by the Golden Scythe Awards Committee in Canada in recognition of excellence in cinematic horror achievements, as assessed by the voting membership, which consists of thirty-five members in the entertainment industry as of 2024.
For the second annual ceremony, presenters for the ceremony included Jeffrey Reddick, Amelie Hoeferle, Grant Feely, Jophielle Love, Christian Stokes, and Kat Conner Sterling.
